name: Orthodox Christian fasting
what_people_do: Observe the Orthodox fasts (no animal products on many days, including Wednesdays, Fridays and long seasons such as the Assumption fast).
why_they_say_it_works: It is a religious duty and a spiritual discipline; many also see it as healthy.

documented_by.source: Gichamo FG et al 2026, BMC Endocr Disord, PMID 41618296
documented_by.quote_or_summary: Addis Ababa, 68 adults with type 2 diabetes fasting for the Assumption fast, August 2024.

evidence.finding: Mean fasting glucose fell 19.56 mg/dL and systolic pressure 9.19 mmHg; no control group.

source.name: Gichamo FG et al 2026, BMC Endocr Disord, PMID 41618296

evidence.population: Meta-analysis, 14 studies (10 pooled), 755 fasters vs 661 non-fasters
evidence.finding: Lower BMI (-0.40); Orthodox fasting lowered total cholesterol by 0.52 mmol/L; Ramadan fasting lowered systolic pressure by 3.83 mmHg; other outcomes unchanged.

source.name: Religious or faith-based fasting and CVD risk factors, systematic review and meta-analysis, 2024, Nutr Metab Cardiovasc Dis, PMID 38508992

harm_note: People on diabetes medicines who change their eating risk going low; the abstract does not discuss hypoglycaemia.
gaps: Pooled studies are mixed populations, not only Ethiopian.
